title: LedgerBench: executable requirement memory for LLM coding agents under changing requirements (open-data Qwen campaign)
description:
LedgerBench is a pre-registered benchmark that drives an LLM coding agent through a frozen 24-task sequence with requirement regime changes, trap tasks and a planted defective test, comparing five memory strategies (summary baseline, append-only test ledger, and three evidence-governed ledgers).

This release contains the harness, the frozen task sequence and hidden oracles, all 60 run logs of a campaign with Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B served locally via Ollama (full prompts and responses, per-iteration workspace git history, ledgers and supersessions, in data/runs/), the excluded attempts, the analysis outputs, and the paper (paper/ledgerbench-qwen.pdf). Every number in the paper is regenerated from the committed data by python -m harness.paper_numbers.
